newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Banco Venezolano de Credito to up capital.
newsitem.headline: Banco Venezolano de Credito to up capital.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan bank Banco Venezolano de Credito has applied to Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) to increase its paid-up capital with a 900 billion bolivar ($1.9 million) share issue, the Bank said.
"We want to strenghten the bank's net worth ... needed for the bank's multiple investment plans," acting bank president German Garcia said.

Pending the CNV's approval, the bank will issue 1.8 million shares, some 8.3 percent of company stock, at market prices, Garcia said. Current shareholders can purchase any shares left over from the offer at 500 bolivars per share.
Company stock followed the bolsa up Thursday, closing ahead 115.00 bolivars at 10,860.00.
